mapper.select: SELECT dev_id,dev_nm,use_yn FROM mst.dev WHERE dev_id=#{id}
mapper.sql: a.asgn_stts_cd='ACTIVE' AND a.bgn_dt <= #{today} AND a.end_dt >= #{today} AND p.prj_stts_cd IN ('PLAN','RUN','HOLD')
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=a.prj_id WHERE a.dev_id=#{id} AND
mapper.update: UPDATE mst.dev SET use_yn=#{use},updated_by=#{actor} WHERE dev_id=#{id} AND use_yn<>#{use}
mapper.select: SELECT d.dev_id AS id,d.mng_no AS "mngNo",d.dev_nm AS name,coalesce(j.cd_nm,d.main_job_cd,'') AS "mainJob",d.emp_se_cd AS "empType" FROM mst.dev d LEFT JOIN cmn.cd_dtl j ON j.cd_grp_id='JOB' AND j.dtl_cd=d.main_job_cd WHERE d.use_yn='Y' AND (d.rsgn_dt IS NULL OR d.rsgn_dt>#{today}) AND (position(lower(#{q}) in lower(d.dev_nm))>0 OR position(lower(#{q}) in lower(d.mng_no))>0) ORDER BY d.dev_nm,d.dev_id
mapper.sql: FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=a.prj_id LEFT JOIN cmn.cd_dtl j ON j.cd_grp_id='JOB' AND j.dtl_cd=a.job_cd WHERE a.dev_id=#{id} AND a.asgn_stts_cd=#{filter}
mapper.select: SELECT a.asgn_id,a.prj_id,p.prj_nm,a.job_cd,j.cd_nm AS job_name,a.bgn_dt,a.end_dt,a.asgn_rt,a.asgn_stts_cd ORDER BY ${order},a.asgn_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.sql: FROM cst.mth_cst c WHERE c.dev_id=#{id} AND c.cst_ym>=#{from} AND c.cst_ym<=#{to}
mapper.select: SELECT c.cst_ym,c.emp_se_cd,c.slry_amt,c.alwnc_amt,c.sins_cmpny_amt,c.rtrpay_acml_amt,c.indv_lbr_cst_amt,c.real_pay_amt ORDER BY ${order},c.mth_cst_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.sql: FROM sys.data_chg_hist h LEFT JOIN sys.user_info u ON u.user_id=h.chg_user_id WHERE ((h.tbl_nm='mst.dev' AND h.obj_rec_id=CAST(#{id} AS text)) OR (h.tbl_nm='mst.dev_work_stts_hist' AND h.data_chg_ty_cd IN ('INSERT','UPDATE','DELETE') AND ( EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mst.dev_work_stts_hist w WHERE w.dev_id=#{id} AND CAST(w.work_stts_hist_id AS text)=h.obj_rec_id) OR CASE WHEN pg_input_is_valid(h.bfr_val,'jsonb') THEN h.bfr_val::jsonb->>'dev_id' END=CAST(#{id} AS text) OR CASE WHEN pg_input_is_valid(h.aft_val,'jsonb') THEN h.aft_val::jsonb->>'dev_id' END=CAST(#{id} AS text)))) AND h.clmn_nm=#{filter}
mapper.select: SELECT h.chg_at AS changed_at,h.tbl_nm AS table_name,h.obj_rec_id AS record_id,h.data_chg_ty_cd AS change_type,h.clmn_nm AS item,h.bfr_val AS before,h.aft_val AS after,coalesce(u.user_nm,'기본 사용자') AS actor ORDER BY ${order},h.data_chg_hist_id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.sql: SELECT d.dev_id,d.mng_no,d.dev_nm,coalesce(v.ptnr_nm,'자사') AS affiliation_name,d.emp_se_cd,e.cd_nm AS emp_type_name,d.grd_cd,g.cd_nm AS grade_name,d.main_job_cd,j.cd_nm AS main_job_name, CASE WHEN d.rsgn_dt<=#{today} THEN '퇴사' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mst.dev_work_stts_hist w WHERE w.dev_id=d.dev_id AND w.work_stts_cd IN ('VACATION','PARENTAL','UNPAID','LEAVE') AND w.bgn_dt<=#{today} AND (w.end_dt IS NULL OR w.end_dt>=#{today})) THEN '휴직' WHEN ca.current_assignment_count>0 AND to_char(ca.latest_assignment_end_dt,'YYYY-MM')<=to_char(CAST(#{today} AS date)+interval '2 months','YYYY-MM') THEN '철수예정' WHEN ca.current_assignment_count>0 THEN '투입중' ELSE '대기' END AS status, ca.current_project_name,ca.current_assignment_count,coalesce(mm.current_month_mm,0.00) AS current_month_mm,coalesce(mm.current_month_mm,0)>1.00 AS over_one_mm,ca.latest_assignment_end_dt,d.dflt_untprc_amt,d.use_yn,d.rsgn_dt, d.vndr_ptnr_id,d.pstn_cd,d.duty_se_cd,d.bsn_part_id,d.hire_dt,d.tel_no,d.email_addr,d.rmrk_desc,d.updated_at FROM mst.dev d LEFT JOIN mst.ptnr v ON v.ptnr_id=d.vndr_ptnr_id LEFT JOIN cmn.cd_dtl e ON e.cd_grp_id='EMP_TYPE' AND e.dtl_cd=d.emp_se_cd LEFT JOIN cmn.cd_dtl g ON g.cd_grp_id='GRADE' AND g.dtl_cd=d.grd_cd LEFT JOIN cmn.cd_dtl j ON j.cd_grp_id='JOB' AND j.dtl_cd=d.main_job_cd LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT count(*) AS current_assignment_count,max(a.end_dt) AS latest_assignment_end_dt,(array_agg(p.prj_nm ORDER BY a.bgn_dt,a.asgn_id))[1] AS current_project_name FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN prj.prj p ON p.prj_id=a.prj_id WHERE a.dev_id=d.dev_id AND ) ca ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT sum(m.mm_qty) AS current_month_mm FROM asgn.asgn a JOIN asgn.asgn_mth m ON m.asgn_id=a.asgn_id WHERE a.dev_id=d.dev_id AND a.asgn_stts_cd!='CANCELLED' AND m.work_ym=to_char(CAST(#{today} AS date),'YYYY-MM')) mm ON true
mapper.select: SELECT job_cd FROM mst.dev_sub_job WHERE dev_id=#{id} ORDER BY job_cd
SELECT skl_cd FROM mst.dev_skl WHERE dev_id=#{id} ORDER BY skl_cd
